2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog
Welcome to ETSU’s Undergraduate Catalog!
ETSU was founded in 1911 with a singular purpose: to improve the quality of life for people in the region and beyond. Surrounded by the beautiful Appalachian Mountains, ETSU is home to 173 highly respected academic programs, many nationally ranked. This catalog is your resource to discover the excellent and unique programs ETSU has to offer, explore your interests, and become inspired to go beyond. Use the navigation to find the answers to your curriculum, admission, policy and academic questions.
In 2026 ETSU was recognized as a national leader in community engagement. ETSU’s commitment to hands-on, community-engaged learning earned the university the Carnegie Foundation’s Community Engagement Classification a designation earned by fewer than 300 institutions out of more than 4,000 colleges and universities nationwide.
If you are looking for another publication such as the graduate catalog, Gatton College of Pharmacy catalog, or the Quillen College of Medicine catalog please use the drop-down menu in the top right corner of the catalog.
If you are not sure which catalog to use or have questions about choosing courses or degree programs, please reach out to an academic advisor.
